already folded automatically by canonicalize_source_system() in retriever/usecase_catalog.py —
you do NOT need to list 'MDC' vs 'mdc', or 'PowerCard' vs 'Power Card'.

punctuation), so this entry changes no grouping — it records the confirmation and pins the

Format: {canonical_name: [variant, variant, ...]}. Add a variant, never remove one silently.
